mapper.select: select * from sys_oss where oss_id = #{ossId} for update
mapper.update: update sys_oss set is_temp = #{isTemp}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = now() where oss_id = #{ossId}
mapper.select: select oss_id from sys_oss where is_temp = 'Y' and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= #{expireTime} order by expire_time, oss_id limit #{limit}
